id1.description: A harmful or undesirable, unexpected effect associated with exposure to any substance or agent, including food, plants, animals, venom from animal stings, or a medication at therapeutic or sub-therapeutic doses.

id3.description: Identification of a substance, agent, or a class of substance, that is considered to be responsible for the Adverse Reaction.

id5.description: Is administration of this Substance/Agent absolutely contraindicated in this individual?

id10.description: Details about each Adverse Reaction Event.

id11.description: Specific identification of the actual Substance/Agent considered to be responsible for the Adverse Reaction event.

id12.description: Clinical manifestation of the Adverse Reaction expressed as a single word, phrase or brief description, e.g. nausea or rash.

id13.description: Narrative description of the Adverse Reaction.

id17.description: The type of Adverse Reaction as determined by the clinician.

id22.description: Degree of certainty, as assessed by a clinician, that the specific Substance/Agent was the cause of the Adverse Reaction.

at24.description: Likely to be the causative agent, but not confirmed by testing or rechallenge.

at25.description: Confirmed as the causative agent, by testing or rechallenge.

id41.description: Narrative description of the clinical management provided.

id50.description: Narrative description of clinician instructions or advice related to future exposure to, or administration of, the Substance/Agent.

ac1.description: Type of substance that was the cause of the Adverse Reaction

ac2.description: Degree of certainty, as assessed by a clinician, that the specific Substance/Agent was the cause of the Adverse Reaction.
